author: Janielys Riviera
title: PAID hiring comic artists, sketch artists, background artists and more
content:
*PAID* HIRING COMIC ARTISTS, WRITERS & MORE ⤵️  

We’re looking for help with the “When the Silent Bird Sings” project.  
WEBTOON: https://www.webtoons.com/en/canvas/when-the-silent-bird-sings/list?title_no=1040171
LEMOON: https://lemoon.io/series/1766943360-when-the-silent-bird-sings

These positions include:  Lineartist, SKETCH ARTIST , colorist, STORYBOARD ARTIST, ANIMATORS, merch designers, background artists, MUSIC PRODUCERS, graphic designers, language translators, VOICE ACTORS, COMIC WRITERS/EDITORS, personal assistants, video/reel editors/promoters & more.   

These positions are paid.
MOST NEEDED: 
-SKETCH ARTIST
-COMIC WRITER/EDITOR
-ANIMATORS
-COLORIST
-VOICE ACTORS
-STORYBOARD ARTIST
-MANHWA/ANIME CONTENT CREATORS (FACE ON CAMERA)
-GAME DEVELOPERS, ETC. (MOBILE, VISUAL NOVEL)
-LANGUAGE TRANSLATORS (CERTIFIED)

If your art style matches the current style we have, then please send a *professional* email to:  

whenthesilentbirdsings@gmail.com 

with the following information:  
-Name, general location 
-Position applying for  
-Resume/Portfolio with previous & current experience & examples 
-Rate per panel & for 60 panels (+/-) 
-Rates for services/etc. (be open to negotiations if necessary) 
-Turnaround Time for 60 panels/other work 
-Programs / Software used (Clip Studio Paint, etc) 
-Preferred Payment Method (However, PayPal is what we will use) 
-Other notable experience / specializations   

*NO DEADLINE, OPEN SUBMISSIONS
*NO DM/COMMENT, EMAIL ONLY

‼️ ABSOLUTELY NO AI USE IN THE PROCESS OR FINAL DELIVERABLES. ‼️  

Comment & share to someone who may be interested 💗
